steps.title: Passphrases, and secrets you can edit
steps.body: Secrets are now locked with a passphrase of at least 8 characters, not only digits, and a much slower key, so a copy of the secrets file is far harder to crack. A secret still on an old 6-digit PIN keeps working, and each time you use it you are offered to set a passphrase there and then. Edit a secret to change its passphrase or its value, with the current one.
